name: grants
sql: select has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.chart_book_series(timestamptz,timestamptz)', 'execute') anon_exec, has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.chart_book_series(timestamptz,timestamptz)', 'execute') auth_exec, has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.chart_book_series(timestamptz,timestamptz)', 'execute') svc_exec

name: summary
sql: with r as (select public.chart_book_series(now() - interval '4 days', now() + interval '10 days') j) select j->'books' books, j->'polled_ok_at' polled, j->'kibl_sweep_ok_at' kibl, jsonb_array_length(j->'events') n_events, length(j::text) bytes from r

name: full
sql: select public.chart_book_series(now() - interval '4 days', now() + interval '10 days') j

name: raw_one
sql: with e as (select event_id from ten287_rec.ticks where book='Superbet' group by 1 order by count(*) desc limit 1) select t.id, t.book, t.event_id, t.back_home, t.back_away, t.book_updated_at, t.seen_at, t.event_status from ten287_rec.ticks t join e using (event_id) order by t.book, t.book_updated_at, t.id
